evaluation_contract: production-extraction-pipeline-v5: repaired source contracts, reviewed text equivalence, incomplete references explicit; final typed values and issues

qualification: Full production pipeline. Reviewed textual equivalents are offline annotations only. Incomplete references cannot establish wrong alternative values; unresolved cases are unscored, not successful. Scores containing incomplete references are conditional diagnostics, not selection or release evidence. Missing real evidence blocks release. No latency measurement.

known_smoke_limitations: Short label/value quantity can yield unsupported_number_format.
